tests.name: the OPC UA adapter worker (D-P6b-0-1) > [DI-31] the OPC UA adapter is a slot of the server, started by the rule of the EMS
the OPC UA adapter worker (D-P6b-0-1) > [DI-32][DI-49] a session, native chunks, a reject-burst alarm and an equipment event from the feed land as sent
the OPC UA adapter worker (D-P6b-0-1) > [DI-20][DI-31] after a relocated endpoint session the data are refused with an alarm and none lands; a valid session restores the feed
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-49] the alarm list and the alarm show a room alarm with its limit, source time and no acknowledgment
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-49][INV-40] a GMP-critical alarm is acknowledged from a kiosk only with a fresh tap and a comment, once; QA without ALARM.ACKNOWLEDGE cannot
alarms routes (DI-49) > [DI-32] the series tags list every released process tag and the EMS room tags
OPC UA readings on the gateway path (DI-32, DI-20) > [DI-32] an OPC UA reading stores raw output equal to the displayed value

OPC UA readings on the gateway path (DI-32, DI-20) > [DI-32] a rounded display, a quality that contradicts the status, a reading of an OPC UA unit without its original record are refused; nothing lands
OPC UA readings on the gateway path (DI-32, DI-20) > [DI-20] readings of a unit whose endpoint session was refused (certificate changed) are refused until a valid session
